records.source_excerpt:
35. Under the Babangida administration, the political
bureau recommended at the federal level,
A.  unicameral legislature and multi-party system
B. bicameral legislature and multi-party system
C. unicameral legislature and two-party system
D. bicameral legislature and two-party system

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: Under the Babangida administration, the political bureau recommended at the federal level,
candidate.explanation: The Political Bureau recommended a unicameral federal legislature and a two-party system. The government accepted the two-party proposal but chose a bicameral legislature, so the recommendation must be distinguished from the arrangement later adopted.

B. decisions taken are defended in spite of
individual opinions
C.  those who hold different views must acquiesce
D. government cannot be personalized

candidate.subject: government
candidate.question: The principle of collective responsibility implies that

options.B: decisions taken are defended in spite of individual opinions
options.C: those who hold different views must acquiesce

candidate.explanation: Collective responsibility requires ministers to defend agreed government decisions publicly despite their private opinions. A minister who cannot support an agreed policy may resign rather than remain in office and oppose it.
